title: AMU Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 02 Senior Resident Posts
description: Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 02 Senior Resident Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the MBBS can grab this chance and apply for the AMU Notification 2026 . Here we included the age limit, selection process, salar structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
